issue.title: File sizes and transfer speeds display JavaScript text instead of readable units

cases.note: Pinned to bf93981, the last commit before the issue #3 repair was merged. It still has the formatting bug (lib/utils/format.ts is byte-identical to the v0.5.5 run commit 4f8b912) and, unlike 4f8b912, its own npm test is tsx --test tests/*.test.ts with tsx 4.23.15 and typescript 5.6.3 in the lockfile and tests/format-baseline.test.ts, so ordinary CI discovers a .ts regression written to tests/. At 4f8b912 npm test only ran tests/*.test.mjs, which made the ordinary-CI discovery gate (rc.25) block this case before any repair. The recorded v0.5.5 run in docs/evidence/github-run-35464615209.json is at 4f8b912; rc.20/rc.21 trials and earlier were taken at 4f8b912 under the old pin and are not comparable. The harness writes patchproof_config over the checkout patchproof.json before each trial.
